UNDERSTANDING-HANDOFF.title: wrapup 이해 변화 요약과 ADR 결정 주체 표시

out_of_scope: Detailed implementation, task-unit and observation-window definitions, and concrete acceptance criteria are deferred to a subsequent SPEC.
Automatic approval, expansion beyond agreed goals or scope, or removal of existing human decision authority and quality gates.
Continuing to invent work after agreed-work completion or goal attainment.
scope: Connect observations, world-state updates, intent decisions, and authorized execution without repeated user instructions to connect the feedback; define the trigger, responsible role, evidence, and recorded disposition for each handoff.

Continue execution within agreed scope; consult the user for goal or scope changes and unresolved uncertainty. On agreed-work completion or goal attainment, record results and termination rationale and stop.
For missed targets, missing measurements, or conflicting assumptions, perform additional measurement and diagnosis within existing scope and authority before deciding the next action.
Keep observations, intents, one or more SPEC/PLAN executions, outcomes, and subsequent decisions traceable through stable references and explicit authoritative records.

Evaluate existing specs/ and work-docs/ conventions first; justify alternative artifact locations by role, lifetime, and operator navigation. Verify discoverability and preserve history and references if paths change.

Demonstrate successful feedback-to-decision continuity in all three consecutive real tasks using execution and conversation evidence, with final assessment by the user. Normal approval questions and justified termination are not failures.
WORLD-INTENT-CLOSED-LOOP.statement: The world model and intent workflow carry observations through state updates into the next decision across three consecutive real tasks without the user having to re-instruct the connection, proceeding to the next execution within the agreed scope. Changes to goals or scope and unresolved uncertainty are referred to the user. The visible artifact layout follows existing workflow conventions, with explicit rationale for any alternative placement.
WORLD-INTENT-CLOSED-LOOP.title: Close the loop between the world model and intent workflow

change_failure_rate.how_measured: 최신 delivery_metrics 스냅샷의 100 * cfr.failed / cfr.total. 스냅샷 갱신은 /hm:metrics (판정 필요, ~25분) — 7일보다 오래된 스냅샷이면 측정이 실패한다. 분모가 작아 태그 하나로 크게 움직인다.

dead_rendered_bytes.how_measured: economics stages 에서 turn 이 0 인 .claude/commands/hm/*.md 바이트 / 전체. 호출 0회는 삭제 후보이지 무가치의 증명이 아니다.

intent_world_closed_loop_cycles.how_measured: Review execution and conversation records for consecutive real tasks, tracing observations through world-state updates to the next decision and, when work remains within the agreed scope, the next execution. Count consecutive tasks meeting this criterion without the user having to re-instruct that connection; the target is three tasks, all successful. Normal approval or decision questions and evidence-backed termination on completion or goal attainment are not failures. The user makes the final assessment from the linked records. Record evidence with each measurement; document the task unit and observation window in the subsequent SPEC. The baseline is unmeasured; no result is asserted yet.

post_merge_churn.how_measured: 최신 delivery_metrics 스냅샷의 100 * churn.ratio. 14–28일 전에 머지된 코드를 본다 (성숙 지연) — 지금 작업의 결과는 2주 뒤에 나타난다. 스냅샷 갱신은 /hm:metrics, 7일 초과면 측정 실패.

task_lead_time_hours.how_measured: stage-spans.jsonl: task_slug 별 첫 start → 짝지은 hm:wrapup end (6h 이내 인접 end, 09-12 이전 end 는 slug null). task 크기에 좌우되므로 오름세를 곧바로 하네스 탓으로 읽지 말 것.

understanding_handoff_rate.how_measured: 최근 /hm:wrapup 10건 각각을 사용자가 판정한다. (1) 완료 시 남은 이해 변화 요약 (바뀐 가정·불변조건·경계, 아직 모르는 것) 만으로 diff 를 읽지 않고 변경을 설명할 수 있었는가, (2) 사용자 모르게 내려진 합의 범위 밖 WHY·WHAT 결정이 없었는가. 둘 다 예인 건수 / 판정 건수 × 100. 요약 섹션이 존재한다는 것만으로는 통과하지 않는다. 각 측정에 판정한 wrapup 을 근거로 남긴다. 요약 기능은 아직 없고 baseline 은 미측정이다 — 결과를 주장하지 않는다. 요약의 형식·위치·길이와 표본 단위는 후속 SPEC 에서 정한다.

wiki_fact_entries_28d.how_measured: scripts/measure_wiki_fact_window.py (PLAN-mission-context-loop ADR-005). 창은 그 skill 이 처음 들어간 가장 이른 v* 릴리스 tag 의 UTC 날짜부터 +28일까지(포함, UTC 날짜 단위). slug 마다 git 이력과 working tree 를 통틀어 가장 이른 날짜로 센다. 창이 닫히기 전에는 측정하지 않는다 (not released → exit 2, window open → exit 3). 판정은 사전 등록된 그대로 적용하고 발동 후 재해석하지 않는다: 5개 이상 → S1(주제별 파일) 을 후보 task 로 등록, 0개 → project-knowledge skill 과 포인터 제거, 1–4개 → S0 유지. 창이 닫힌 뒤 첫 /hm:wrapup 5.7 "Measure outcomes now?" 에서 운영자가 측정하고, 선택한 조치는 후속 task 의 RESEARCH/PLAN 에 남긴다. 수동 S1–S3 확인은 일회용 clone 에서만 한다 (이 wiki 를 오염시키지 않도록).

evidence.text: sdlc-three-loops-gap (Python diff), 3 review runs x 4 dispatches: the security lens alone raised every P1 at the wrapup Step 5.7 shell-quoting seam, 5 across runs; core raised distinct consistency and robustness P1s; tests-lens Pass-1 items were dropped at Pass 2 in 2 of 3 runs; concurrency returned 0 findings in all 12 dispatches

intent-file-inputs review (run f8dec5471aad, 2026-09-28): round 1 dispatched 7 lenses in 4 dispatches plus codex. The one functional recipe failure (intent-layer proposal path always passing --declined-file, which the CLI refuses when every candidate is accepted) came from codex alone; no Claude lens raised it. The tests lens alone found that the AC-001 property could not tell rstrip from strip. Concurrency returned 0 findings in round 1 and in confirm-1, as on sdlc-three-loops-gap. Distinct lenses and the heterogeneous model each contributed findings no other voter raised; the concurrency lens contributed none on this CLI-parsing diff.

intent-feedback-continuity (2026-09-28/29): four /hm:review runs on a Python task. The concurrency lens and the Codex voter each surfaced P0/P1 defects no other lens raised (post-commit-pop trial guard, fence re-check on the success path, publish revalidation), while the tests lens mostly repeated standing P2s. Supports the fan-out recall gain on Python; cost was 4 dispatches x 2 passes per run plus confirmation passes.

intent-layer-improvements (2026-09-29): /hm:review run cda10095b67a on a Python + template diff, 4 dispatches x 2 passes + codex, then two confirmation passes. The security lens alone found the heredoc-sentinel injection channel (P1 in Pass 1, P2 after Pass 2). The core lens alone found the confirm-1 P1 (verdict skip rule keyed on a row no step wrote). Codex contributed three findings no Claude lens raised (PIDA accepted), one corroborating security. The concurrency lens dropped all three of its Pass 1 findings in Pass 2 and returned 0 at confirm-2. Distinct lenses and the heterogeneous model again each contributed findings no other voter raised; the concurrency lens contributed none that survived.

open_questions.claim: needs_revalidation is a report only: the autopilot objective gate reads approval_valid from derive() without a staleness map, so stale cited code never halts autopilot

evidence.text: verified during the assumption-entry-and-evidence-locator review: autopilot_caps calls world.derive(loaded, raw) and reads only approval_valid

open_questions.claim: A fresh verification-cache marker asserts that a fingerprint is unchanged, not that the suite ran or passed; the two diverge silently.

evidence.text: Observed 2026-09-20: a wrapup accepted a fresh marker and skipped the suite, landing tests/unit/test_land_hold.py on main in a state that could not be COLLECTED - the module raised at import so the suite aborted rather than reporting a failure, and it sat on main until an unrelated task ran the suite. The commit changed both source and tests, which the cache claims to invalidate on.

open_questions.claim: A single front door that owns the intent and project-knowledge procedures (Maker reads them on demand; the skills are not model-invocable; unnamed goal/fact/status requests are routed to Maker by the always-loaded pointer, mid-stage included) lets a task's feedback reach the next decision without the operator re-instructing the connection.

Writing a decision made in conversation into the in-flight task's most downstream artifact before replying, and naming the task's latest artifact on resume, keeps a pause, compaction or new session from losing progress.

purpose.statement: 프로젝트에 맞춘 개발 하네스로, 기본 품질을 지키면서 작업을 빠르고 효율적으로 완수하게 한다. HOW 는 AI 가 최대한 가져가고, WHY·WHAT·트레이드오프는 사람이 소유하며, 작업이 끝나면 코드와 함께 사람의 시스템 이해도 갱신되게 한다. 모델과 호스트의 발전을 빠르게 측정해 반영하고, 제값을 못 하는 장치는 걷어낸다.
purpose.vision: 사용자가 의도와 필요한 결정만 주면, 합의된 범위와 권한 안에서 /hm: 가 단계별 지시 없이 작업을 검증된 완료까지 이끈다. 사용자에게 오는 질문은 WHY·WHAT·되돌리기 어려운 트레이드오프로 한정된다. 완료 시점에 사용자는 diff 를 읽지 않고도 시스템의 가정·불변조건·경계가 어떻게 바뀌었는지, 무엇이 아직 모르는 채로 남았는지 설명할 수 있다. 각 프로젝트에는 필요한 구성만 렌더되고, 모델·호스트가 대체한 장치는 검증을 거쳐 제거된다.
